title: kochia scoparia f. littorea
intro: Kochia scoparia f. littorea, commonly known as Korean burning bush or Chinese burning bush, is a plant species belonging to the Amaranthaceae family. It has been traditionally used in Eastern medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Kochia scoparia f. littorea include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides. The bioactive constituents of this plant are also responsible for its potential anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and anti-aging effects.
